title: Capture the 2026-11-10 MVP interview as hi criteria and add the 1.0 roadmap, test plan and draft issue mapping
description: Capture the 2026-11-10 MVP interview as hi criteria and add the 1.0 roadmap, test plan and draft issue mapping
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement text changes: the PR captures Leif's 2026-11-10 interview decisions as new hi criteria (FLOW-21, FLOW-22, DRIVE-24, KNOW-30, LIFE-17 to LIFE-25) and adds roadmap and test-plan documentation. No helper behavior, stage semantics, retention or SpecSync contract changes.
acceptance_criteria: hi check passes with the 13 new criteria (FLOW-21, FLOW-22, DRIVE-24, KNOW-30, LIFE-17 to LIFE-25) and the INTENT.md index regenerated; docs/roadmap-1.0.md defines milestones to 1.0, each tied to one of the four bar items of LIFE-21 with a done definition and its test, and includes the session-slug-folder migration design; docs/test-plan-1.0.md covers the per-repo dogfood checklist, the flake tracker and two-week clean window, migration fixtures from every 0.x tag (0.1.0 to 0.5.0) and the host-matrix e2e harness design; the PR body carries the draft issue list grouped by milestone with acceptance criteria, dependencies and the mapping of existing open issues; no helper behavior, requirement text, stage semantics, retention or SpecSync contract changes

answers.constraints: hi IDs are never reused or renumbered (hi/AGENTS.md); existing criteria are never reworded or removed, so conflicts with FLOW-17 (Windows via WSL vs best-effort) and KNOW-29 (roll-up reads as move vs copy-never-move) are flagged in the PR body instead of edited; docs must match current main behavior (FLOW-18)
